reviews.summary: I could only check the diff and the code, not a timed run. The temporary failing spec could not be written, and the one Playwright run I made (smoke spec, desktop) timed out after 600 s with no output.

The deliverable is repo-only, and I could not read it. The raw GitHub URLs returned 404, the live site does not serve it, and the prompt had no READ-ONLY CHECKOUT section or test output. No criterion was observable, so the verdict is inconclusive.

The live site ships the client part: lobby-series and results-series containers and the «Room so far» texts in en.json. The server, tests, PROTOCOL.md and screenshot could not be read, so the criteria that depend on them are unchecked.

The deployed host runs with saw.enabled=false, so the saw cannot be played there. The flag-off battle frames look normal, but both e2e runs failed without a usable result (weapon-looks timed out at 600 s, weapon-reload exited 1, output not read), and I did not run the unit tests or the saw sim myself.

Docs-only task, so I checked it by reading DESIGN.md and viewing the redrawn docs/arena-elements.png; I ran no browser scenarios. The three acceptance points are met, and the changed files are only DESIGN.md and docs/arena-elements.*.

The text edits are right: round length is named by the balance.json keys with 180 s, §5.3.7 records v6 with the link, and only GAME-DESIGN.md changed. It fails on the size limit: the file is 39910 characters against 38 000, and it grew by about 600.
